meta.title: Participation status tracking updates correctly just before the live window closes
gaps: Timing the observation to exactly 30 seconds before the submission window closes
Verifying that participation indicators update without stale caching delays in real time
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Timing the observation to exactly 30 seconds before the submission window closes; Verifying that participation indicators update without stale caching delays in real time

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on the buyer's Participants tab as required for this state.
Verify the invited vendor is listed and no longer offers Add Bid, indicating its bid is recorded.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses tab to inspect the buyer-facing participation counters.
Assert that the submitted vendor response is present and the participation count reflects the latest bid.
